messages:
maria: Heads up — HF import failing for gptx-chat-v2 when running the converter. Getting a safetensors shard count mismatch and a missing special token during tokenizer load. Logs below.

maria: ```
ValueError: safetensors index mismatch: found 2 shards but index lists 3
During conversion: Missing special token '<|response|>' in tokenizer config
Model: hf://org/gptx-chat-v2 (revision: main)
Command: redwood-convert --repo hf://org/gptx-chat-v2 --out /tmp/gptx
```

kevin: Is this the repo that switched to split-safetensors + new tokenizer format last week? If so we should try pinning the revision first.

sam: Quick workaround that worked for me: pin to the commit hash and set HF token.
sam: ```bash
export HF_TOKEN="***"
redwood-convert --repo hf://org/gptx-chat-v2 --revision abc123def --skip-index-check --out /tmp/gptx
```

sam: Note `--skip-index-check` is a bit sketchy but buys time. Also double-check that the repo has an accompanying `.safetensors.index.json` in the LFS/hub snapshot.

alex: FWIW I ran into a separate but related symptom: our key mapping expects `transformer.wte` but newer HF exports use `embed_tokens`. There's an open converter PR that adds a weight-key-rename map. Try: `--weight-key-map '{"transformer.wte":"embed_tokens"}'`

maria: Pinned to abc123def and passed HF_TOKEN; converter finished and model loads in staging. The missing special token still needs an explicit validation step — it was silently dropped earlier which caused chat template mapping to misalign.

maria: I'll open an issue and a tiny unit test that fails when special tokens are absent. Filing issue: https://redwood.internal/issue/512

kevin: Please add an e2e that does a full HF download (huggingface-cli snapshot) to catch auth + missing-index problems instead of only calling the hub API. Also make revision pinning part of our onboarding checklist.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: converter v0.9.1 -> canary at 1799123600 :rocket:

maria: Thanks — PR incoming with test + docs updates.
